title: Software foundations
summary: Python from two angles, TypeScript on Node, React with Next.js, Postgres, and AI coding tools with production discipline.
intro: The general-purpose software stack under platform and field work. This module covers Python from two angles (packaging, environments and testing for a platform; integrations, services and data transformation), TypeScript on Node.js, full-stack applications with React and Next.js, schemas, indexing and partitioning in Postgres, and shipping production code with Claude Code and other AI coding tools. Most of the glue between systems is written in this stack, so it has to be second nature.
